mapper.select: SELECT r.round_id, r.group_id, DATEDIFF(#{settlementDate}, r.start_date) DIV 7 AS week_no, DATE_ADD( r.start_date, INTERVAL (((DATEDIFF(#{settlementDate}, r.start_date) DIV 7) - 1) * 7) DAY ) AS week_start_date, DATE_SUB(#{settlementDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS week_end_date, g.min_count FROM rounds r INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id WHERE r.round_status = 'ONGOING' AND DATE_SUB(#{settlementDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) BETWEEN r.start_date AND r.end_date AND DATEDIFF(#{settlementDate}, r.start_date) >= 7 AND MOD(DATEDIFF(#{settlementDate}, r.start_date), 7) = 0 ORDER BY r.round_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO weekly_settlements ( round_id, week_no, user_id, approved_post_count, created_at ) SELECT participant.round_id, #{weekNo}, participant.user_id, COUNT(p.post_id), NOW() FROM round_history participant LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.round_id = participant.round_id AND p.user_id = participant.user_id AND p.post_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.posted_at >= #{weekStartDate} AND p.posted_at < DATE_ADD(#{weekEndDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE participant.round_id = #{roundId} GROUP BY participant.round_id, participant.user_id
